_A_FORM_COMPONENT_DESCRIPTION_: The AForm component builds a complete form from a configuration array. Each item in data selects a UI component through its type, uses its id as the model key, and accepts all props supported by that UI component. The form manages the shared model, validation errors, dependencies, responsive layout, read-only mode, events, and content slots.
_A_FORM_BASIC_DESCRIPTION_: Pass field configurations through data and bind one object with v-model. The value of every field is stored under its id.
_A_FORM_DEPENDENCIES_DESCRIPTION_: A field can declare one condition as a dependencies object or multiple required conditions as an array. AForm supplies the current model to every UI component automatically.
_A_FORM_VALIDATION_READONLY_DESCRIPTION_: The errors object is keyed by field ID. Form-level error navigation and required-field information can be configured independently, while readonly switches every field to its read-only representation.
_A_FORM_EVENTS_SLOTS_DESCRIPTION_: Listen to update:modelValue for the complete model and change for details about the changed field. Slots insert content before or after the form and its field container.
_A_FORM_PROPS_CLASS_COLUMN_DEFAULT_DESCR: Default CSS class applied to each configured field when the item does not define its own classColumn.
_A_FORM_PROPS_CLASS_COLUMNS_DESCRIPTION_: CSS classes applied to the container that holds all fields from data.
_A_FORM_PROPS_DATA_DESCRIPTION_: Required array of field configurations. Every item needs a type and id, and may contain props supported by the selected UI component.
_A_FORM_PROPS_ERRORS_DESCRIPTION_: Object containing validation errors keyed by field ID. Values are passed to the corresponding fields and can also be displayed in the form error summary.
_A_FORM_PROPS_IS_REQUIRED_DESCRIPTION_: Explicitly controls whether the form displays required-field information. When omitted, the value is inferred from configured fields.
_A_FORM_PROPS_MODEL_VALUE_DESCRIPTION_: The complete form model. Field values are read from and written to keys matching their IDs.
_A_FORM_PROPS_SHOW_ERRORS_DESCRIPTION_: Controls display of the form-level error summary. Field-level errors remain available to individual components.
_A_FORM_PROPS_SHOW_REQUIRED_TEXT_DESCRIP: Controls display of the required-fields notice above the fields.
_A_FORM_PROPS_TAG_DESCRIPTION_: HTML tag used for the root element of the form.
_A_FORM_PROPS_TEXT_ERROR_HEADER_DESCRIPT: Custom heading for the form-level error summary.
_A_FORM_PROPS_TEXT_REQUIRED_DESCRIPTION_: Custom text for the required-fields notice.
_A_FORM_PROPS_USE_FLAT_ERRORS_DESCRIPTIO: When enabled, errors are resolved directly by field ID. Disable it when nested container errors follow the nested model structure.
_A_FORM_PROPS_USE_FLAT_MODEL_DESCRIPTION: When enabled, container fields work with the shared flat model. Disable it to store container values in nested objects.
_A_FORM_PROPS_USE_HTML_ID_AS_KEY_DESCRIP: Uses each field's resolved HTML ID as its Vue key instead of the array index.
_A_FORM_EVENTS_CHANGE_DESCRIPTION_: Emitted after a field changes. The payload contains the field ID, new and previous values, complete model, item data when available, and reactive props.
_A_FORM_SLOTS_FORM_PREPEND_DESCRIPTION_: Content rendered at the beginning of the form, before required information and errors.
_A_FORM_SLOTS_FORM_PREPEND_AFTER_REQUIRE: Content rendered after the required-fields notice and before the error summary.
_A_FORM_SLOTS_FORM_DATA_PREPEND_DESCRIPT: Content rendered inside the field container before configured fields.
_A_FORM_SLOTS_FORM_DATA_APPEND_DESCRIPTI: Content rendered inside the field container after configured fields.
_A_FORM_SLOTS_FORM_APPEND_DESCRIPTION_: Content rendered at the end of the form after the field container.
